# Welcome

This is my academic website showcasing research, publications, and presentations.

## About Me

I'm a postdoctoral researcher at Erasmus MC / GGD Rotterdam-Rijnmond and PDPC collaborator working on new methods and data streams for infectious disease surveillance. I am broadly interested in pandemic preparedness, infectious disease epidemiology and surveillance, the role of misinformation and mistrust on disease transmission, and newer technologies including AI / ML.
